column7: POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/break-glass authenticated by a restricted PAT (project, environment, permission or CIDR restriction) activated break-glass and granted the token OWNER the configured emergency role at the project (201 before the fix): activation is deliberately not RBAC-gated, so the ADR-042 restriction never reached it through Authorize, and a token confined below its owner could raise its owner's privileges. Fixed per Andrei's decision of 2026-10-11 (ADR-042 addendum): ActivateBreakGlass refuses any request carrying a PAT restriction before any other check (ErrRestrictedPATCannotBreakGlass, 403, no activation recorded), the same shape as the PAT-mint refusal. Red before the fix for every restricted persona of the PAT-GUARD-1 fixture, with unrestricted-PAT controls green. Raised by PAT-GUARD-1's inventory (#3062), decided and fixed by PAT-GUARD-2
